title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1988-09-11
source: Master: Nakamichi CM300/cp4's>Marantz PMD-420>Cass(m), Nak DR-2>Tascam CDRW2000>CD Recorded from the taper section by Jon Pasternak Extraction: CD>xACT 2.00a (cdparanoia)>WAV>FLAC, all tracks extracted with no errors by Dave Mallick

ai_review.summary: High‑fidelity audience recording of a breezy 1988 Spectrum show, highlighted by Garcia’s recovered voice and strong vocal delivery.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as the best source for this 1988 show, offering clear, hi‑fi audience sound despite a slight speed/pitch issue from the Jay Ashley remaster. Musically it’s described as a fun, breezy performance with Jerry Garcia’s vocals back and full of energy onstage.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers are favorable (one 4‑star rating, the other neutral FYI). The show is described positively and the source is noted as high‑quality, leading to a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, high‑fidelity audience capture; however the Jay Ashley remaster runs slightly fast/sharp, causing minor pitch issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A breezy, fun performance typical of the 1988 Spectrum dates, with strong vocal presence and an upbeat vibe throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s voice had returned and he was belting out the tunes, clearly enjoying himself onstage.
